title: GUNS COST TWICE AS MUCH TO CRAFT
why: His order of 2026-10-15: guns should be more expensive to craft. Each of the four gun recipes on the bench (Compact SMG, Burst Carbine, Auto Rifle, Riot Scattergun) now asks for twice the parts it did. Nothing else on the bench moved. The old rule that a gun recipe must cost less in parts than the gun costs to replace is relaxed to under twice that, since these four can not be bought at the counter anyway.
now: The four craftable guns now cost twice the parts at the bench.
